title: SG-6.1.4 Reconcile character tests with schema, validation and BootScene source
summary: Character tests must assert real behavior in the schema, validateWorld and BootScene, so they fail when that code is missing.
description: Context: character tests exist in game/tests/characterSchema.test.ts, game/tests/validator.test.ts and game/frontend/tests/bootSceneCharacters.test.ts. They are reported as passing. Desired behavior: each suite asserts observable behavior of characterSchema (game/src/content/schema.ts), validateWorld (game/src/content/loader.ts) and BootScene character wiring (game/frontend/src/phaser/BootScene.ts). Expected result: removing the code under test makes the matching test fail. Why: passing tests that do not exercise the source give false confidence.
acceptance_criteria: Given the characterSchema tests, when characterSchema defaults, required idle animation or interaction handling is removed, then at least one test in game/tests/characterSchema.test.ts fails
Given the validateWorld tests, when the scene character check is removed from validateWorld, then a test in game/tests/validator.test.ts fails
Given the BootScene character tests, when createCharacter or the shutdown cleanup is removed, then a test in game/frontend/tests/bootSceneCharacters.test.ts fails

in_scope: Test assertions for characterSchema, validateWorld scene characters and BootScene character wiring
preserve: Existing public exports of schema.ts, loader.ts and BootScene.ts

technical_constraints: Phaser stays mocked via vi.mock in BootScene tests
Tests use zod and the real source modules, never mocks of the code under test
definition_of_done: All three requirements have an Act and a Verify unit
Evidence ticket confirms the three test files pass
